title_candidates: Gemini 3.5 Flash now has built-in computer use
summary: Google made computer use a built-in Gemini 3.5 Flash capability for agents that operate across browser, mobile, and desktop environments.

primary_source.title: Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
primary_source.author: Google DeepMind
key_facts: Google made computer use a built-in capability in Gemini 3.5 Flash.
The capability was previously available as a standalone Gemini 2.5 computer-use model.
Developers can use it through the Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Google says safeguards include optional confirmation for sensitive actions and stopping tasks when indirect prompt injection is detected.

prerequisites: A harmless browser task to test

steps.instruction: Choose a safe task that uses public information, such as checking a website for broken navigation.
Do not connect accounts, payments, production tools, or private data during the first test.
Run the task in the demo, API, or enterprise environment and watch the proposed steps.
Require confirmation for any sensitive or irreversible action before trying real work.
Review the trace for prompt-injection warnings, unexpected clicks, or unnecessary tool use.
